**What now exists:** \\u0060HomeStore\\u0060 (\\u0060src/Coanda.Daemon/Store/HomeStore.cs\\u0060) is the store for every home. \\u0060AddCoandaStore\\u0060 swaps it in with \\u0060services.Replace\\u0060 for Fisher\\u0027s \\u0060DocumentStore\\u0060, and \\u0060StoreConfiguration.Open\\u0060 returns one. Its disposal waits for pending finalizers, which closes coanda.db connections that SQLite had left open on a delay. Tests are \\u0060StoreDisposalTests\\u0060, plus the \\u0060FinalizerHold\\u0060 helper and its non-parallel \\u0060FinalizerHoldCollection\\u0060.\\n- **Gotchas:** the root bug is in Fisher (commands never disposed), so a store built with \\u0060DocumentStore.For\\u0060 directly doesn\\u0027t get the wait. Never hold the finalizer thread outside \\u0060FinalizerHoldCollection\\u0060, because that stalls every other test\\u0027s store disposal. On macOS, closing any file handle on coanda.db drops all of SQLite\\u0027s locks on that file in the process, so lock probes must come first or be made from another process.\\n- **Left undone, on purpose:** the SQLite Error 5 \\u0022active statements\\u0022 flake (probably the same Fisher leak, seen when a pooled connection is reused). Also left: reads of a store\\u0027s files while it\\u0027s still open (\\u0060SessionPrincipalTests\\u0060, \\u0060ModuleSettingsTests\\u0060), and an upstream Fisher fix. Because of those flakes, criterion 4\\u0027s run of consecutive full-suite passes isn\\u0027t met (longest streak 9). The new tests haven\\u0027t run on CI
